mathematical_contract.range: Every membership decision compares the queried exact cut against both retained fragment cuts under the fragment's construction policy. Endpoint inclusion is explicit per call and policy mismatch is an error.
mathematical_contract.boundary: A ray origin on either retained fragment endpoint is Boundary even when that endpoint is excluded from half-open crossing ownership. Incidence on the unused part of the supporting circle is not a fragment boundary.
mathematical_contract.ownership: Forward traversal includes its start and excludes its end; reversed traversal excludes the ascending-range start, includes the ascending-range end, and negates the contact orientation. This assigns every split vertex to exactly one adjacent traversal crossing.
mathematical_contract.interaction_authority: Rational contacts and the optional monotone semicircle parameter map now reuse one rational system, selected-cusp projection, reduced incidence, and lazily reduced diameter data. Ordinary callers request contacts only. A retained map is built only when a subfragment has an interior contact that must be ordered against its cuts.
mathematical_contract.policy: STRICT and APPROXIMATE_512 execute the same exact predicates. Comparisons that remain unresolved at Hyperlimit's 512-bit boundary return Ordering uncertainty in STRICT and consume the policy terminal before equality in APPROXIMATE_512.
mathematical_contract.representation: The retained subfragment remains one pointer. No endpoint field element, primitive element for independent roots, sampled tolerance, or finite approximation is introduced.
